video_title: 🔥 Every point from Knicks' ECF Game 1 comeback to force overtime | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks' comeback strategy in Game 1
quotes.excerpt: We kept fighting, kept believing. Just kept chipping away.

text_blocks.speaker: Lisa
text_blocks.text: How did you guys get this one back? You guys outscored them since that point. 44 to 11. That's the last seven, seven and a half in the fourth quarter and overtime. What was different? What started working for you guys?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Found a way. I don't have an answer for you. We got some stops. We kept fighting, kept believing. Just kept chipping away. They were playing great basketball and just found a way. I really don't have an answer.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his performance and team's belief in comeback win
quotes.excerpt: I'm just happy we found a way to win. We kept believing in each other.
quotes.quote: I'll realize after the fact. I'm just happy we found a way to win. We kept believing in each other, taking our shots, kept running. My teammates kept believing in me, my coaches. It's all credit to them. We can still learn from a win. We didn't play our best obviously until the end, but we can still learn from a win. We got a lot of work to do.
